2645-5963-6256-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Muraganda Raceway.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Muraganda Raceway's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X creature cards in all graveyards.
3899-6972-7231.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

215-969-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-969-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2033-4478-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-4478-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-4478-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-5078-7650.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1606-2750-6871.description:
Give the artifact type to Ley Weaver using Memnarch.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat step 2.

1308-1563-2457-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3532-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2178-2292-3817-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-2292-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1018-4050-4871-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
1018-4050-4871-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Skullwinder and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Skullwinder, adding {4}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

5231-5853-5929.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
5231-5853-5929.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Snail, adding {R}.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Leyline of Transformation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2366-4488-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1850-3702-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Blossoming Sands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Blossoming Sands, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Blossoming Sands trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

3398-4050-4538.notablePrerequisites:
Dune-Brood Nephilim does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block Hellkite Charger and Dune-Brood Nephilim.
You control at least eight lands.
3398-4050-4538.description:
Declare Dune-Brood Nephilim and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Dune-Brood Nephilim.
Dune-Brood Nephilim triggers, creating a 1/1 Sand creature token for each land you control.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Dune-Brood Nephilim and Hellkite Charger as attackers.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Sand creature tokens, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

1030-1636-2034-3924.notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
1030-1636-2034-3924.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Deep Forest Hermit, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Deep Forest Hermit from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Deep Forest Hermit enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Deep Forest Hermit trigger, creating four 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
The Squirrel tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm four times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
